# Maps — Curated Travel Maps
# https://maps.girard-davila.net/
# Format: https://llmstxt.org
# Last updated: 2026-04-12

> Hand-picked travel maps from real family experiences across South East Asia and Europe.
> GPS-precise spots, honest notes, opening hours, prices. No generic tourist lists.

## About

Maps is an open-source curated travel map project built from personal travel experience. Each destination contains GPS-verified POIs with category filters, opening hours, prices, and insider notes. Maps are built with Hugo, Leaflet.js, GeoJSON and TopoJSON, deployed on GitHub Pages.

Any user can fork the repository, add new places to a GeoJSON file, and submit a pull request. New places can also be submitted directly from the browser using the in-map **🐙 GitHub → Submit PR** toolbar flow — no local setup required.

## Destinations

- [Koh Samui, Thailand](https://maps.girard-davila.net/koh-samui/) — Island-wide overview: beaches (Chaweng, Maenam, Choeng Mon, Lamai), Big Buddha Temple, Bophut Fisherman's Village, Karma Two Palms Beach Club, Nathon Pier. Includes a Lamai Village area-guide POI that links to the dedicated Lamai map.
- [Lamai Beach, Koh Samui](https://maps.girard-davila.net/lamai/) — Neighbourhood-level detail for Lamai: local restaurants, Muay Thai gyms (Punch It, Chatpichit), markets (Lotus Fresh, Lotus's), spas (Tamarind Springs, Phu's Massage, Community Club), temples (Wat Lamai, Wat Ratchathamaram Red Temple), beaches (Crystal Beach), bakeries, bars and cafés. 28 GPS-verified POIs.
- [Hoi An, Vietnam](https://maps.girard-davila.net/hoi-an/) — An Hoi peninsula: curated restaurants, cafés, local market, Buddhist pagoda, river viewpoints around the Na Mom Homestay area.
- [Gulf of Thailand Fishing Expedition](https://maps.girard-davila.net/fishing-boat/) — 2-day boat trip from Nathon Pier: red snapper shelf, tuna alley, overnight island anchorage, hazard markers, fuel barge. Demonstrates the TopoJSON multi-segment route + waypoints format.

## GeoJSON POI Schema

Every destination's data lives in `static/<destination>/locations.geojson` as a standard GeoJSON `FeatureCollection`. Each feature must follow this schema:

```json
{
  "type": "Feature",
  "properties": {
    "name":     "String — place name (required)",
    "category": "String — must match a known category (required)",
    "address":  "String — full street address or area description (recommended)",
    "notes":    "String — insider description, what makes it worth visiting",
    "hours":    "String — opening hours, e.g. '09:00–18:00 daily' or 'Open 24h'",
    "phone":    "String — international format, e.g. '+66 77 256 500'",
    "url":      "String — website or Instagram URL",
    "price":    "String — entry fee or price range, e.g. 'from ฿1,500'"
  },
  "geometry": {
    "type": "Point",
    "coordinates": [longitude, latitude]
  }
}
```

**Coordinate order is `[longitude, latitude]`** — the GeoJSON standard (opposite to Google Maps).

Only `name`, `category`, and `geometry` are strictly required. All other properties are optional but encouraged for quality.

### Categories

Use one of the established categories for the destination's map to get the right colour-coded icon. Unrecognised categories fall back to grey `📍`.

**Lamai map** (`layouts/lamai/list.html` `CATEGORY_COLORS`/`CATEGORY_ICONS`):

| Category   | Icon | Colour    |
|------------|------|-----------|
| Restaurant | 🍽️  | `#f97316` |
| Bakery     | 🥐  | `#eab308` |
| Café       | ☕  | `#92400e` |
| Muay Thai  | 🥊  | `#ef4444` |
| Market     | 🛒  | `#7dd3fc` |
| Bar        | 🍺  | `#8b5cf6` |
| Spa        | 💆  | `#ec4899` |
| Fitness    | 💪  | `#06b6d4` |
| Landmark   | 🪨  | `#64748b` |
| Temple     | 🛕  | `#a78bfa` |
| Beach      | 🏖️  | `#0ea5e9` |

**Koh Samui map** (`layouts/koh-samui/list.html`):

| Category   | Icon | Colour    |
|------------|------|-----------|
| Beach      | 🏖️  | `#0ea5e9` |
| Restaurant | 🍽️  | `#f97316` |
| Activity   | 🎯  | `#22c55e` |
| Hotel      | 🏨  | `#8b5cf6` |
| Shopping   | 🛍️  | `#ec4899` |
| Area Guide | 🗺️  | `#1a3a5c` |

Adding a new category requires adding a matching entry to both `CATEGORY_COLORS` and `CATEGORY_ICONS` in the relevant `layouts/<destination>/list.html`.

## Contributing New Places — Step-by-Step

### Option A — In-browser (no local setup)

The fastest path for adding a small number of places to an existing map:

1. Open any map page, e.g. `https://maps.girard-davila.net/lamai/`
2. Click **🛠️ Tools** in the top-left overlay to reveal the toolbar
3. Click **🐙 GitHub** → **Sign In** tab
4. Authenticate via **Device Flow** (enter the displayed code at `github.com/login/device`) or paste a Personal Access Token
5. Go to the **Submit PR** tab
6. Select the destination GeoJSON file (e.g. `static/lamai/locations.geojson`)
7. Paste your new feature(s) following the schema above, or load a local file
8. Fill in a branch name and PR title, then click **Submit PR**
9. The tool will fork `alx/travel-guide` under your account (if not already forked), commit the updated GeoJSON to a new branch, and open a pull request via the GitHub API

### Option B — CLI / Git workflow

**Step 1 — Fork the repository**

```bash
# Via GitHub CLI
gh repo fork alx/travel-guide --clone --remote

# Or manually: fork on github.com, then:
git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/travel-guide.git
cd travel-guide
git remote add upstream https://github.com/alx/travel-guide.git
```

**Step 2 — Create a feature branch**

```bash
git checkout -b add-lamai-places
```

**Step 3 — Edit the GeoJSON file**

Open `static/lamai/locations.geojson` (or another destination) and append new features to the `"features"` array. Keep JSON valid — run a quick check:

```bash
python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('static/lamai/locations.geojson')); print('valid')"
```

Minimal example of a new feature to append:

```json
{
  "type": "Feature",
  "properties": {
    "name": "My Favourite Café",
    "category": "Café",
    "address": "42 Haad Lamai Road, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui",
    "notes": "Tiny roaster run by a Thai-French couple. Best cold brew on the beach road.",
    "hours": "08:00–16:00",
    "phone": "+66 81 234 5678"
  },
  "geometry": {
    "type": "Point",
    "coordinates": [100.0491, 9.4703]
  }
}
```

> **Tip — get coordinates**: right-click any location in Google Maps → "What's here?" shows `lat, lng`. Reverse the order to `[lng, lat]` for GeoJSON.

**Step 4 — Commit and push**

```bash
git add static/lamai/locations.geojson
git commit -m "lamai: add My Favourite Café and 2 other spots"
git push origin add-lamai-places
```

**Step 5 — Open a Pull Request**

```bash
gh pr create \
  --repo alx/travel-guide \
  --title "lamai: add 3 new spots" \
  --body "Added: My Favourite Café (Café), Jungle Smoothie Bar (Bar), Beach Yoga Club (Fitness). All GPS-verified on-site."
```

Or open a PR on `github.com/<your-username>/travel-guide` → **Contribute → Open pull request**.

### PR Guidelines

- One destination per PR is preferred
- GeoJSON must be valid (no trailing commas, correct coordinate order)
- Include `notes` describing *why* a place is worth visiting — not just its type
- `hours`, `phone`, and `url` are optional but strongly encouraged
- Coordinates should be verified (on-site GPS, Google Maps pin, or Nominatim)
- Do not include `"premium": true` — that field is managed by maintainers

### Adding a New Destination (requires Hugo files)

To add a completely new destination (not just POIs to an existing map):

1. Create `static/<destination>/locations.geojson` — the GeoJSON data file
2. Create `content/<destination>/_index.md` — minimal Hugo content file:
   ```yaml
   ---
   title: "My Destination"
   ---
   ```
3. Copy `layouts/lamai/list.html` to `layouts/<destination>/list.html` and update:
   - `window.MAP_CONFIG.title`
   - `window.MAP_CONFIG.geojsonUrl` → `'/<destination>/locations.geojson'`
   - `window.MAP_CONFIG.embedPath` → `'/<destination>/'`
   - Initial map centre: `map.setView([lat, lng], zoom)`
   - `CATEGORY_COLORS` and `CATEGORY_ICONS` for the new destination's categories
   - Page header text in `{{ define "main" }}`
4. Open a PR with all three files

## Map Toolbar

Every map page has a toolbar with these actions:

| Button | Action |
|--------|--------|
| 📥 GeoJSON | Download the map's raw GeoJSON data file |
| 🗺️ GPX | Export all visible POIs + routes as GPX (OsmAnd, Garmin, etc.) |
| `</>` Embed | Copy `<iframe>` snippet with live preview; src uses `?embed=1` |
| 🔗 Share | Copy current URL (including active filter) to clipboard |
| 📂 Load | Load custom GeoJSON/TopoJSON from file, URL, or GitHub forks |
| 🐙 GitHub | Sign in · browse repos · fork & submit PR |

## Load Custom Data (📂 Load)

Three tabs in the Load modal:

1. **File** — file-picker; accepts `.geojson`, `.topojson`, `.json`
2. **URL** — fetch from any public URL (GitHub raw, S3, Gist, etc.)
3. **GitHub Forks** — lists all public forks of `alx/travel-guide`; per-fork branch dropdown; recursive tree scan for `.geojson`/`.topojson` under `static/`; one-click load onto the map

TopoJSON is converted to GeoJSON via `topojson-client@3` before rendering. Loaded data appears as a removable overlay layer with a yellow badge in the sidebar.

## GitHub Integration (🐙 GitHub)

Three-tab panel in the toolbar:

1. **Sign In** — GitHub Device Flow OAuth (show a code, enter at github.com/login/device) or Personal Access Token. Token stored in `localStorage['github_pat']`.
2. **Load GeoJSON** — search any of the user's repos for `.geojson`/`.topojson` files.
3. **Submit PR** — forks `alx/travel-guide`, commits GeoJSON to `static/<name>/locations.geojson` on a new branch, opens a pull request via GitHub API — all from the browser.

GitHub Device Flow uses a Cloudflare Worker CORS proxy (`workers/github-proxy.js`); the two endpoints `/github-device-code` and `/github-device-token` proxy GitHub's OAuth API with CORS headers. No client secret required.

## OsmAnd & GPS Export

- Every POI card has a **🗺️ OsmAnd** link (`geo:lat,lon`) — tapping on Android opens OsmAnd or any registered geo: handler
- The **GPX export** button serialises all currently visible POIs as `<wpt>` waypoints and route LineStrings as `<trk>` tracks in GPX 1.1 format

## Embed Mode

Append `?embed=1` to any map URL to get a map-only view (no header, footer, toolbar, sidebar, contact form). An inline script adds `embed-mode` to `<html>` before first paint so there is no flash of chrome.

```html
<iframe
  src="https://maps.girard-davila.net/lamai/?embed=1"
  width="100%" height="500" frameborder="0"
  style="border-radius:12px;"
  title="Lamai Beach — Maps">
</iframe>
```

Add `&filter=Spa` to pre-filter on load. Any category name works as a filter value.

## TopoJSON Format

The fishing-boat expedition uses non-quantized TopoJSON (no `transform`). Arc coordinates are absolute `[lng, lat]` pairs. Two named objects: `route` (LineString geometries referencing arc indices) and `waypoints` (Point geometries with direct coordinates). Loaded via `topojson.feature()`.

## Technical Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Static site | Hugo |
| Maps | Leaflet.js 1.9.4 + OpenStreetMap tiles |
| Data formats | GeoJSON · TopoJSON (topojson-client@3) |
| Auth | GitHub Device Flow via Cloudflare Worker CORS proxy |
| Forms | Formspree (mqegoqqz) |
| Analytics | Google Analytics G-WDJF6L9P30 |
| Hosting | GitHub Pages — maps.girard-davila.net |
| CI/CD | GitHub Actions → upload-pages-artifact → deploy-pages |
| DNS | Cloudflare (CNAME flattening, apex → www redirect) |

## Key Files

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `static/lamai/locations.geojson` | Lamai Beach POI data (28 places) |
| `static/koh-samui/locations.geojson` | Koh Samui island overview POIs |
| `static/hoi-an/locations.geojson` | Hoi An POI data |
| `static/fishing-boat/route.topojson` | Fishing expedition — route + waypoints (TopoJSON) |
| `layouts/lamai/list.html` | Lamai map: Leaflet, categories, sidebar, filters |
| `layouts/koh-samui/list.html` | Koh Samui map |
| `layouts/hoi-an/list.html` | Hoi An map |
| `layouts/fishing-boat/list.html` | TopoJSON expedition demo |
| `layouts/partials/map-toolbar.html` | Toolbar: download, GPX, embed, share, load, GitHub |
| `layouts/partials/contact-form.html` | Floating Formspree contact form |
| `layouts/_default/baseof.html` | Site shell, embed-mode CSS, GitHub config injection |
| `workers/github-proxy.js` | Cloudflare Worker: GitHub Device Flow CORS proxy |
| `hugo.toml` | Site config — GitHub OAuth params |
